definitions.quality_covered_fall_event: At least one positive window under unchanged quality-v2 labels and gates; an operator action event is not a verified impact.
definitions.dynamic_hard_negative: Verified normal walking/stand_up/sit_down/lie_down/get_up_from_floor recordings; static negatives counted separately within all normals.
definitions.quality_rejected: Disjoint count after v2 labeling; ignored windows are never negatives. No threshold changed.

packet_quality.timestamp_source: collector elapsed_seconds; no clock retiming or annotation shifts
packet_quality.threshold_basis: Frozen using firmware/collector source and label-blind session_01/session_02 acquisition characterization only. Observed development trial rates 26.37-85.94 Hz. Floor 20 Hz is below the slowest observed development mean but rejects sparse streams. Require real samples in >=24/30 100ms bins, >=90% sample span and <=100ms unsupported endpoint distance. Preserve 250ms maximum interpolation gap; never extrapolate. Neither test labels nor test performance selected thresholds.
